title: The White-Hair Star
text: A smudge low in the west after sunset, with a pale tail that wasn't there last month. The Vell saw it first. They've stopped singing.

lines.text: "The white-hair star. It comes before. Eleven times it came, and eleven fires."
"We do not sing while it is up. We wait. You should wait too."

choices.label: "This time is different."
choices.reply: "Eleven times somebody said so," says the Marro, not unkindly.

tags: act 2, survey, comet varro, vell, keeper, omen
notes: STORY.md §13: Comet Varro, the Vell's white-hair star, returns before each purge. There is no condition for where a body is, so it is tied to foundry-found (the Clause is close). The Vell version; white-hair-star-seen is the one for colonies that never heard the Keeper's Song.
